art_note: Clean model photography with clear garment details, though standard studio staging keeps it from high editorial tier.
desc_en: Elevate your practice with this yoga top engineered for uncompromising performance. Crafted from polyester spandex double fabric, it offers a tight yet elastic hold designed to absorb sweat and breathe. Built-in medium-thick pads provide a soft, cool touch for complete comfort through every session or daily pursuit. Durable and resilient against wear, this piece maintains its structure over time. Made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Eleve su práctica con este top de yoga diseñado para un rendimiento sin concesiones. Confeccionado en tejido doble de poliéster y elastano, ofrece una sujeción firme pero elástica que absorbe la humedad. Incorpora almohadillas de grosor medio, suaves y frescas al tacto, pensadas para brindar confort durante cualquier entrenamiento o actividad cotidiana. Su diseño resistente al desgaste mantiene la forma lavado tras lavado. Disponible para pedidos bajo demanda con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Polyester spandex double fabric
· Built-in medium-thick pads
· Hand wash in cold water
· Made to order and worldwide shipping
